analyze_text.title: Classify text for harmful content
analyze_text.description:
Grade a piece of text for Hate, SelfHarm, Sexual and Violence, and optionally match it against blocklists.
The response's `categoriesAnalysis` gives a severity per category -- 0, 2, 4 or 6 by default, or 0 to 7 with EightSeverityLevels. The service never says "blocked": choosing the threshold is the caller's job, and it is normally different per category.
Pass `blocklist_names` to also check the text against exact-match term lists; without it, blocklists are not consulted at all. Matches come back in `blocklistsMatch`. With `halt_on_blocklist_hit` set, a blocklist match short-circuits the AI analysis, so `categoriesAnalysis` comes back empty -- check `blocklistsMatch` before concluding the text was clean.
Text is limited to 10,000 characters per call; longer input has to be chunked.
analyze_text.notes: Maximum 10,000 characters. Blocklists are only applied when blocklist_names is passed.

text.description: The text to classify. Up to 10,000 characters.

categories.description: Which harm categories to analyse. Omit for all four, which costs the same.

blocklist_names.description: Blocklists to match the text against, from list_blocklists. Without this, no blocklist is consulted.

halt_on_blocklist_hit.description: Skip the AI analysis when a blocklist term matches. Faster, but categoriesAnalysis then comes back empty.

output_type.description: FourSeverityLevels returns 0, 2, 4 or 6. EightSeverityLevels returns 0 to 7 and is text-only.

output.description: A severity per category, plus any blocklist matches.

categoriesAnalysis.description: One entry per category, each with category and severity.

blocklistsMatch.description: Each match, with blocklistName, blocklistItemId and blocklistItemText.

analyze_image.title: Classify an image for harmful content
analyze_image.description:
Grade an image for Hate, SelfHarm, Sexual and Violence. Pass either `image_content` as base64 or `blob_url` pointing at a publicly reachable image -- one or the other, not both.
Only four-level severity is supported for images, and blocklists do not apply. As with text, the service grades rather than blocks; the threshold is yours to choose.
Images must be at least 50x50 pixels and under 4 MB; JPEG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF and WEBP are accepted.
analyze_image.notes: Images must be 50x50 pixels or larger and under 4 MB. Blocklists do not apply to images.

image_content.description: The image as a base64 string. Use this or blob_url, not both.

blob_url.description: A publicly reachable URL to the image. Use this or image_content.

categories.description: Which harm categories to analyse. Omit for all four.

output_type.description: Only FourSeverityLevels is supported for images.

categoriesAnalysis.description: One entry per category, each with category and severity 0, 2, 4 or 6.

list_blocklists.title: List the resource's text blocklists
list_blocklists.description: Every blocklist configured on this Content Safety resource, with its name and description. The names here are what analyze_text's `blocklist_names` takes -- a blocklist that is never named in an analyse call has no effect on anything.

get_blocklist.title: Get a blocklist
get_blocklist.description: One blocklist's name and description. It does not include the terms -- list_blocklist_items does that.

create_or_update_blocklist.title: Create a blocklist or change its description
create_or_update_blocklist.description:
Create a blocklist, or update the description of one that exists. Creating it does not populate it -- add terms with add_blocklist_items -- and does not apply it to anything, since analyze_text has to name it explicitly.
Sent as a JSON merge patch, which is what this endpoint expects.
create_or_update_blocklist.notes: An empty blocklist matches nothing, and a blocklist not named in analyze_text is never consulted.

blocklist_name.description: The blocklist's name. Creating one that exists updates it.

description.example: Terms we never want echoed back to customers

output.description: The blocklist as created or updated.

delete_blocklist.title: Delete a blocklist
delete_blocklist.description: Remove a blocklist and every term in it. Irreversible. Any analyze_text call still naming it will start failing rather than silently ignoring it, so check what references the list before deleting.

blocklist_name.description: The blocklist to delete, with all its terms.

list_blocklist_items.title: List the terms in a blocklist
list_blocklist_items.description: Every term in a blocklist, each with its id, text, description and whether it is a regular expression. The ids are what remove_blocklist_items takes.

skip.description: How many terms to skip, for paging.

get_blocklist_item.title: Get one blocklist term
get_blocklist_item.description: A single term by its id -- its text, description and whether it is treated as a regular expression. Useful for resolving a `blocklistItemId` that analyze_text reported in `blocklistsMatch` back to the term that caused the match.

blocklist_item_id.description: The term's id, from list_blocklist_items or an analyze_text match.

text.description: The term itself, or the regular expression.

properties.description: {type: string, description: "Why it is on the list."}

isRegex.description: Whether text is a regular expression rather than a literal.

add_blocklist_items.title: Add terms to a blocklist
add_blocklist_items.description:
Add or update terms in a blocklist. Each entry is `{"text": "...", "description": "...", "isRegex": false}`; a term with an `isRegex` of true is matched as a regular expression, which is how you catch spelling variants without listing them all.
Up to 100 terms per call, each up to 128 characters. Changes take a few minutes to reach the analysis endpoint, so a term added and immediately tested will usually not match yet.
add_blocklist_items.notes: Up to 100 terms per call. Changes take a few minutes to take effect on analyze_text.

blocklist_items.description: The terms, each {"text": "...", "description": "...", "isRegex": false}. Up to 100 per call.

output.description: The terms as stored, with their assigned ids.

blocklistItems.description: Each with blocklistItemId, text, description and isRegex.

remove_blocklist_items.title: Remove terms from a blocklist
remove_blocklist_items.description:
Delete terms from a blocklist by id. Irreversible, and the terms stop being matched a few minutes later once the change propagates -- so a term removed and immediately tested may still match.
The ids come from list_blocklist_items.
remove_blocklist_items.notes: Takes a few minutes to take effect on analyze_text.

blocklist_item_ids.description: The term ids to delete, from list_blocklist_items.
